title: mizerStomach 0.1.0
text: Initial release. Added tools validate stomach-content data fit normal, smoothly truncated-exponential, Gaussian-mixture distributions log predator-prey mass ratios. Added diagnostics plots fitted distributions, including histogram violin-plot views. Added transformations prey-number prey-biomass weightings. Added support transferring fitted feeding kernels MizerParams objects, including Gaussian-mixture kernels. Updated mizer integration mizer 3.4’s S3 MizerParams objects using public parameter accessors, removed unused mizerExperimental dependency. Added interactive Shiny gadget fitting adjusting distributions. Added barnes_data example dataset, package articles, expanded test suite.
